message: region `r` answers a value of type `String`, which may point into the memory the region reclaims
label: this has type `String`
notes: a `String` is a descriptor over a second block, a struct is a block and a closure is a record; every one of them would point at reclaimed memory
help: answer a scalar - Int, Bool, Char, Float or Unit - which survives the reset by value; a reference has to be built outside the region until typed regions (docs/memory-model-v2-design.md §4, S3) can promote one

message: `out` is bound outside region `s`, and the value stored into it has type `String`
label: this store leaves the region
notes: a store is the one escape channel a scope check can see; a call that stores the value for you is the program's obligation (docs/memory-model.md MM-ALLOC-16) until typed regions
help: a reference allocated inside the region would outlive it: store a scalar, or bind the target inside the region
